description:
## Issue summary

React Native (Expo) mobile flows for Restoration & History mobile with offline-safe behaviour.

**Project:** great-ptw-loto-ai-app
**Sprint:** SP-03.03 (Execution order: 3)
**Layer:** MOB
**Priority:** Medium (3)

## Positive test cases

- Core workflow usable offline with queued sync
- Auth tokens stored securely
- Offline changes reconcile without data loss
- UI reflects connectivity state clearly

## Negative test cases

- Authoritative data stored only in SQLite
- Sync overwrites newer local changes silently
- Crash on network loss mid-submit

## Acceptance criteria

- Mobile screens implemented for sprint scope
- Offline queue + sync tested
- TypeScript lint passes

## Definition of Done

- Expo app runs on iOS/Android simulator
- Offline scenario manually verified
- No secrets in mobile bundle

---

## Existing notes

Mobile (React Native) implementation for **SP-03.03 — Restoration & History**.

**Functional requirements:** FR-LTO-012 to FR-LTO-014

## Screens

* Restore Equipment
* Remove Locks
* Remove Tags
* Restoration Verification
* LOTOTO History

## Capabilities

* Offline restoration recording
* Evidence capture
* QR/Barcode verification (if enabled)
* Background synchronisation
